page_title: UNI 1-0 PAU | Union Berlin v St. Pauli 30/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow shows his agility and makes a save.
90+4' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) is booked for saying more than Bastian Dankert was willing to tolerate.
90+3' St. Pauli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+2' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nikola Vasilj intercepts the ball.
90+1' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Bo Svensson has decided to make a change. Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) replaces Tom Rothe.
89' A substitution has been made. Jordan Siebatcheu goes off and Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) comes on.
88' St. Pauli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

87' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
85' Karol Mets (St. Pauli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
84' St. Pauli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
83' A cross from a corner kick by St. Pauli is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
83' Here is a change. Johannes Eggestein is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli).
83' The game has come to an end for Lars Ritzka. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli).

82' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for St. Pauli.
81' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
80' Union Berlin exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
78' The referee allows time for a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach will be replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
77' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
76' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
75' St. Pauli keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
73' The possession of the ball – 44:56.
71' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
70' St. Pauli hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Bo Svensson prepares a substitution. Yorbe Vertessen is replaced by Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).
67' Substitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) in, Lucas Tousart out.
66' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for St. Pauli.
63' St. Pauli string together a series of short passes.
61' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Morgan Guilavogui will be replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
61' Substitution. Elias Saad (St. Pauli) replaces Robert Wagner.
59' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
59' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
57' Union Berlin are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
56' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
53' Wonderful movement by Union Berlin. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

52' CLOSE! Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
51' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
51' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Corner kick. Union Berlin will have an opportunity.
50' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle. Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
48' The St. Pauli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
47' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Bastian Dankert has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) for his blatant foul.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:2.

42' Union Berlin slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
40' Problems for Alexander Blessin as Eric Smith is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) replaces him.
38' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
37' Great teamplay by St. Pauli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

36' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Nikola Vasilj anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
34' 1 - 0 Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Nikola Vasilj. 1:0.
34' The resulting set piece from Union Berlin is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

34' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a decent save to thwart the attempt.

32' Union Berlin players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
29' Union Berlin are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
26' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Nikola Vasilj is alert and denies him.
24' Neat passing move from Union Berlin in order to create new attacking opportunities.
21' Half-chance! Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) plays a pass into the box, but Frederik Ronnow reacts well to snuff out the attack.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.
16' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
15' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) offside.
13' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

11' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. St. Pauli are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
9' It looks like Robert Wagner (St. Pauli) saw red with that tackle. Bastian Dankert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

6' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
5' The St. Pauli players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
2' The Union Berlin players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
St. Pauli will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Bastian Dankert.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
